title: Glowing fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x="52" y="22" width="4" height="30" rx="1" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="62" y="22" width="4" height="30" rx="1" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="52" y="24" width="14" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fff3a0"/>
  <rect x="52" y="30" width="14" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fff3a0"/>
  <rect x="52" y="36" width="14" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fff3a0"/>
  <rect x="52" y="42" width="14" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fff3a0"/>
  <rect x="52" y="48" width="14" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fff3a0"/>
  <!-- hose reel on back -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="52" r="8" fill="#ff4d4d"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ff8080"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="52" r="2" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  <!-- light bar -->
  <rect x="38" y="28" width="18" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff3333"/>
  <rect x="40" y="29.5" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ff9999"/>
  <rect x="48" y="29.5" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffcc66"/>

  <ellipse cx="47" cy="26" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#ff6666" opacity="0.35"/>

  <rect x="34" y="36" width="40" height="24" rx="4" fill="#ff2b2b"/>
  <rect x="34" y="36" width="40" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff6b6b"/>

  <rect x="58" y="40" width="13" height="11" rx="2" fill="#aee7ff"/>
  <rect x="58" y="40" width="13" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e0f6ff"/>
  <!-- front cab window -->
  <rect x="48" y="40" width="8" height="11" rx="2" fill="#aee7ff"/>
  <!-- rear body -->
  <rect x="14" y="46" width="22" height="16" rx="3" fill="#e01e1e"/>
  <rect x="14" y="46" width="22" height="5" rx="2" fill="#ff5c5c"/>
  <!-- stripe -->
  <rect x="14" y="56" width="60" height="4" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x="12" y="60" width="64" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ffd633"/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="68" r="9" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="68" r="5" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="68" r="2" fill="#fff0b3"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="68" r="9" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="68" r="5" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="68" r="2" fill="#fff0b3"/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="71" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#fff7b0"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- headlight glow -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="52" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#fff7b0" opacity="0.25"/>
  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <circle cx="10" cy="42" r="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="32" r="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#ff9999"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#ff9999"/>
</svg>
